annotations.title: Extract Custom JSON Schema from Document

description: Extract strict, structured JSON matching any custom JSON schema or field template from a PDF or image (PNG, JPG, WEBP, TIFF). Ideal for developer pipelines, ERP/accounting ingestion, and custom document fields. Works on the free tier (2 free docs/day) or with a Smart OCR API key (10 free credits at https://smartocr.dev).

api_key.description: Optional Smart OCR API key from https://smartocr.dev (can also be sent via x-api-key header). If omitted, uses the free tier (2 free docs/day).

file_base64.description: Base64-encoded document content (raw base64 or data:...;base64,... URI). Provide either file_url or file_base64.

file_url.description: Public HTTP/HTTPS URL to a PDF, PNG, JPG, WEBP, or TIFF document to extract.

schema.description: Target JSON schema or key-value object template describing the fields to extract (e.g., {"vendorName": "string", "invoiceNumber": "string", "invoiceDate": "string", "totalAmount": "number", "lineItems": [{"description": "string", "quantity": "number", "amount": "number"}]}).

name: extract_document_json
